adrs_created.title: Swift 6 Strict Concurrency Adoption
adrs_created.consequences: Compile-time safety, ~91 hours effort, risk of performance overhead

adrs_created.title: Actor-Protocol Conformance Strategy
adrs_created.decision: Protocol-first isolation annotation with @preconcurrency migration path
adrs_created.consequences: Clear isolation semantics, potential API evolution needs

adrs_created.title: @unchecked Sendable Safety Policy
adrs_created.decision: Three-level hierarchy: Proper Sendable > @preconcurrency > @unchecked with SAFETY

adrs_created.title: Async-Safe Locking Migration
adrs_created.decision: Actor-based isolation primary, Mutex secondary for hot paths
adrs_created.consequences: Sendable by default, potential context switch overhead

adrs_created.title: Test Infrastructure Concurrency Compliance
adrs_created.decision: Three-tier approach: Sendable doubles, Swift 6 patterns, property-based testing
adrs_created.consequences: Full CI/CD compliance, additional test boilerplate

preconcurrency_vs_unchecked.context: External libraries vs internal types needing Sendable
preconcurrency_vs_unchecked.decision: ADR-003 establishes: @preconcurrency for external libs, @unchecked for internal non-Sendable state with documentation
preconcurrency_vs_unchecked.rationale: @preconcurrency is upgradeable (library may add Sendable later), @unchecked is permanent but sometimes necessary

protocol_crossing_actor_boundaries.context: Protocol methods must work across actor boundaries
protocol_crossing_actor_boundaries.decision: ADR-002: Protocols define isolation, implementations match
protocol_crossing_actor_boundaries.rationale: Compiler enforces consistency, prevents accidental data races

api_compatibility_preservation.context: Public APIs must not break during migration
api_compatibility_preservation.decision: Use @preconcurrency on existing protocols, @unchecked Sendable with SAFETY for non-breaking changes
api_compatibility_preservation.rationale: Maintains ABI compatibility while enabling Swift 6 compliance

nslock_migration_path.decision: ADR-004: Actor-based isolation as default, Mutex for profiled hot paths
nslock_migration_path.rationale: Actors provide Sendable automatically, Mutex requires ~Copyable and profiling

testing_concurrent_code.context: Need to validate concurrent behavior doesn't regress
testing_concurrent_code.decision: ADR-005: Property-based testing with Swift Testing, invariant verification
testing_concurrent_code.rationale: Property tests catch edge cases unit tests miss, formal invariants document assumptions
